methodology.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on training data
methodology.evaluation_principle: Compare baseline, neural-network, optimization, and regularization approaches

data_leakage.note: Scalers are fitted only on training data.

reproducibility.note: Fixed random state and TensorFlow seed are defined.

early_stopping.note: EarlyStopping with restore_best_weights is used in relevant experiments.

model_comparison.note: Multiple architectures and regularization strategies are compared.

metrics.note: Regression and classification use task-appropriate metrics.

unit_tests.note: Automated tests cover preprocessing, model outputs, architecture properties, and evaluation metrics.

notebook_execution.note: The notebook is executed automatically in CI as a smoke test.

independent_test_set.note: The notebook primarily uses train-validation evaluation rather than a separate held-out test set.

limitations: The datasets are small and come from scikit-learn.
Results depend on a single train-validation split.
No independent held-out test set is used.
The project focuses on educational deep-learning fundamentals rather than production deployment.
No external benchmark or cross-validation study is included.

portfolio_assessment.overall_positioning: reproducible and tested hands-on deep-learning project

recommended_next_steps: Add a dedicated held-out test set or cross-validation.
Persist actual experiment metrics generated by the notebook.
Add confidence intervals or repeated-split analysis.
Optionally publish the latest CI status in the README.
